about_the_game:
🧠 Short Description

You are an ordinary student at “Wuhshan University.” One day at the library, you absentmindedly scratched an itch caused by a chronic skin condition—only to be misinterpreted by the girl sitting across from you as engaging in lewd behavior. What began as a misunderstanding quickly spirals into disciplinary action, online outrage, social shaming, and mental collapse.
Now, caught between fragmented evidence and an indifferent system, you must fight for yourself, your family, and your future.

📖 About This Game

“Do you even know what you did wrong?”
“No one will believe you. She told her story first.”

🔍 What Can You Do?

🧩 Reconstruct the Truth

Piece together the real story using phone footage, audio recordings, chat transcripts, psychological reports, and witness testimonies. Every piece of evidence can be interpreted—or twisted.

💬 Choose With Care

Will you comply? Fight back? Go public? Every response, every silence, every compromise affects your fate in the school, the media, and the legal system.

📱 Simulated Public Opinion

Navigate a storm of uncontrollable commentary from news outlets, blogs, trending hashtags, anonymous forums, and student groups. Public perception might destroy you—or become your only hope for vindication.

🧠 Mental Health System

Your psychological state evolves with the story. Excessive stress, isolation, or humiliation can lead to hallucinations, breakdowns, or even muteness. Staying sane is your first challenge.

⚖️ Legal & Bureaucratic Trials

Face campus investigations, internal hearings, and possibly court. Even if you win your case—can you ever really return to normal?

🎭 Multiple Endings – No “Perfect Justice”

  • Punished and ostracized, but mentally intact

  • Vindicated in court, yet your academic future destroyed

  • Mentally broken, you leave school and flee abroad

  • Rare: full understanding, institutional apology, and restored reputation

  • Or… you stay silent, and disappear quietly into oblivion

📌 This Game Explores:

  • The gray areas of sexual misconduct accusations

  • Narrative power in media and online spaces

  • The cold mechanics of institutional risk management

  • The struggle of individuals under systemic and cognitive bias

  • PTSD, identity collapse, and the emotional toll on families

⚠️ Content Warning:

This game contains sensitive social topics, including misinterpreted sexual misconduct, psychological stress, PTSD, self-harm, institutional neglect, and online harassment.
Recommended for players aged 16 and up. Please play with discretion.

🧑‍💻 A Note From the Creators:

We don’t intend to pass judgment on any real-life case.
We only wish to simulate the terrifying experience of being misunderstood,
and let you ask yourself:

When your voice is taken away—what can you do?

📖 Legal Disclaimer

This is a work of fiction. All characters, organizations, and events depicted in this game are entirely fictional. Any resemblance to actual persons, living or dead, or real events is purely coincidental.

The game is intended to explore public themes and does not represent or target any real individuals or incidents.

Please approach the content responsibly and do not interpret any part of the game as factual or legally binding.
